activity_summary: After the rent the coffer held twenty-five pounds exactly. You set sixty shillings apart in canvas for Thursday's carrier, inside that count, and not as a second total. You entered the shares at eight shillings and twelve, and you made no remark. You wrote that the king was in the coffer also. You shut both locks.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Made the entry and shut both locks.

facets.activity: Entered twenty-five pounds and shut both locks
